title: Select configured worker models independently
summary: Reworked model selection: provider sections lead to model choices, effort has its own slider, and configured worker runtimes can keep their own model pin.

sections.title: What this ship changes for you
items: Reworked model selection: provider sections lead to model choices, effort has its own slider, and configured worker runtimes can keep their own model pin.
Hid worker controls in Solo mode and removed duplicate voice controls while keeping dictation.
Kept composer menus aligned with their controls when interface zoom changes.
Made worker catalogues easier to browse with provider navigation, recent choices, Popular and Newest sorting, Coding and Free filters, and stable effort variants.
Kept runtime registration stable across development reloads.
Grouped streamed worker transcript fragments while preserving message boundaries and tool results.
Added a read-only merge preview for the selected approved lane, with a chooser when several are ready.
